videos.title: 6 ways to build a better agent
videos.description: A cinematic guide to harness choice, tools, context, model routing, goals, and when to bring in an agent team.

videos.title: October cybersecurity threats are overwhelming
videos.description: A satirical look at security updates, a compromised dependency, and deployment disruptions.

videos.title: System prompts encode the workflow
videos.description: System prompts carry workflow decisions: when to plan, retry a tool, edit code, and run tests.

videos.title: Tool schemas and harness overhead
videos.description: Tool definitions consume context too. A simpler harness can change the cost of the same model.

videos.title: Dynamic workflows
videos.description: Give an agent a tool and let it write orchestration code, delegate work, and bring the results together.

videos.title: CupidBot: retrieval methods
videos.description: CupidBot explains Find, BM25, embeddings, rerankers, GraphRAG, and agentic search through one urgent question.

videos.title: CliffCompaction
videos.description: Why deliberately trimming old tool output can help an agent continue a long coding task.

videos.title: Hermes: memory in layers
videos.description: Build agent memory in layers, from repository rules and session history to reusable and self-written skills.

videos.title: FrontierMemory: lessons from work logs
videos.description: Turn past work logs into useful lessons, instructions, and skills for the next task.

videos.title: Recursive Language Models
videos.description: Let the model explore a large context with code instead of placing every detail in its prompt.

videos.title: Four ways to route models
videos.description: Rules, classifiers, cost-aware selection, and cascades offer four ways to choose the next model.

videos.title: Verifiers’ Law
videos.description: Why checking an answer can be easier than finding it, and how that shapes progress in coding and math.

videos.title: Harness evolution or just more retries?
videos.description: Test a self-improving harness against simple retries at the same budget and on held-out tasks.

videos.title: Long-running agents overfit validation
videos.description: A competition story about agents optimizing validation noise, with four ways to guard against it.

videos.title: Multi-agent coding needs isolation
videos.description: Managers, dependency graphs, worktrees, merges, and tests make parallel coding work reviewable.

videos.title: Office politics at machine speed
videos.description: An agent swarm finds more bugs, burns more tokens, and sometimes sabotages its own teammates.

videos.title: NeuroGolf: managing agent work
videos.description: What a coding competition teaches about task queues, memory, isolated workspaces, and approval gates.

videos.title: More agents is not a strategy
videos.description: Tool overload, coordination costs, and amplified errors explain why adding agents can hurt performance.

videos.title: Patterns and problems in multi-agent systems
videos.description: A short on Anthropic’s research into patterns and problems in emerging multiagent systems.

featuredTalk.title: Harness Engineering Deep Dive
featuredTalk.description: The full introduction to engineering coding agents: model choice, retrieval, memory, tool use, feedback loops, and system architecture.
